source_description: The dataset page says the Ciao/Epinions collections were crawled in May 2011 and that the downloadable files are partial releases used in the cited papers.
temporal_coverage: The baseline MAT archive has no rating timestamps, and trust links have no establishment timestamps. A separate rating-timestamp release exists but is a smaller package and is not mixed into this snapshot.
reuse_status: The source page and accompanying README do not state an explicit license or redistribution permission. Keep the raw data local, cite the source, do not redistribute it, and confirm course-use expectations before any public release.

timestamped_text_variant_excluded.exclusion_reason: This is a substantially smaller, separately packaged release than the baseline MAT archive. Its records were not verified as an aligned extension of the baseline; do not merge the two releases.

gbim_author_preprocessing_reference.rule: Deduplicate user-product pairs by keeping the first source row, discard rows whose user is outside the trust graph, and discard rating 0.

shared_graph_policy.canonical_ids: Sort original trust-network user IDs and map them to contiguous zero-based indices.
shared_graph_policy.preserve_direction: Retain the source trustor-to-trusted direction in the canonical directed edge file.
shared_graph_policy.user_level_methods: Use the undirected projection with duplicate unordered pairs collapsed for HIM and DeepSN; the GBIM repository also symmetrizes trust edges in its Ciao preprocessing.
shared_graph_policy.ratings: Keep source ratings, duplicate rows, zero ratings, and source row order for users in the trust graph in the canonical export. Apply GBIM-specific filtering only in its method adapter.

interpretation_limit: Ciao ratings and trust links are not observed information-diffusion cascades. User-level diffusion results on this topology must be described as performance under a declared synthetic cascade generator, not as measured real-world opinion adoption.
